richiami.difetto: As part of the Heat Treatment process quench cracks can occur.  These are not normally visible to the human eye.  However if the nuts are over torqued during fitment they can appear.
richiami.rimedio: Customer are being advised to check and replace cracked nuts with a quality assured replacement component.
richiami.titolo: POSSIBILITY OF QUENCHING CRACKS FROM HEAT TREATMENT IN THE MIDDLE HEX FLANGE SECTION OF THE WHEEL NUT
